scripts.firebase:deploy: node scripts/bump-version.js && npm run build && npm run native:prune-dist && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting
scripts.electron:dev: node scripts/generate-electron-icon.mjs && npm run build:native && npm run native:prune-dist && electron .
scripts.native:assets: node scripts/generate-electron-icon.mjs && node scripts/prepare-native-assets.mjs && npx @capacitor/assets generate --android --assetPath assets --iconBackgroundColor "#ae0714" --iconBackgroundColorDark "#ae0714" --splashBackgroundColor "#000000" --splashBackgroundColorDark "#000000"
scripts.electron:pack:win: npm run native:assets && npm run build:native && npm run native:prune-dist && node scripts/electron-win-release.mjs
scripts.cap:sync: npm run native:assets && npm run build:native && npm run native:prune-dist && npx cap sync
scripts.android:apk:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug

build.productName: Los sonidos de la pasión de Cristo
